space.noneDetail: Your own space appears after your first sign-in to OpenCloud, and team spaces once an admin adds one of your groups in files.yaml.
space.keeping: Earlier versions are kept by OpenCloud; deleted files stay in the recycle bin {{days}} days.
space.name: Name
space.empty: This folder is empty. Drop files here to upload them.
space.drop: Drop files here to upload, or sync this space with the OpenCloud desktop app at {{url}}.

preview.title: Preview
preview.inLink: In a link to {{to}}, no password, expires {{date}}.
preview.inLinkPassword: In a link to {{to}}, password set, expires {{date}}.

share.title: Share {{name}}
share.rules: A link to someone outside always expires, at most {{days}} days from today; files.yaml sets that.
share.forHint: A name or an email address, shown on the Links page. Leave it empty for anyone with the link.
share.passwordRequired: Required by files.yaml. Send it another way than the link, such as by text message.
share.passwordOptional: Optional. Send it another way than the link.
share.expiresHint: At most {{days}} days: {{date}} at the latest.
share.sendPassword: Send the password separately, not in the same message as the link.

links.title: Links
links.description: Every link to someone outside expires; the longest a link may last is {{days}} days, set in files.yaml.
links.stopped: The link to {{name}} no longer works.
links.problemDetail: It was made in an OpenCloud app, and files.yaml asks for a password. Stop it and make a new one with a password.
links.auditNote: From OpenCloud's audit log, which records when a link is opened, not from where or which file of a folder.

bin.title: Recycle bin
bin.description: Deleted files are kept {{days}} days, then removed for good. Earlier versions of a file are under the file itself.
bin.leavesDetail: Their own files go to {{manager}} on that day, not to the recycle bin.
bin.name: Name

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.description: Spaces, their members and quotas are set in files.yaml and read again within a minute.

file.error: files.yaml has a mistake; the last good version is still in use
file.readOnly: Spaces, members and rules change in {{path}}, not here.

sync.title: OpenCloud
sync.description: Files keeps OpenCloud in step with the file after each change and every five minutes.
sync.changed: Last time: {{created}} made, {{updated}} updated, {{disabled}} disabled, {{links}} links shortened, {{purged}} removed from recycle bins.

leaving.title: Leaving
leaving.description: When someone leaves, their own files go to a space their manager manages, and their OpenCloud account is turned off.
leaving.planDetail: Identity does not say who leaves or who their manager is, so an admin plans it here. On the day, Files copies the person's own files into a space named after them, managed by their manager.
leaving.dateHint: The handover runs with the first sync of that day.

settings.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of Files for access.
settings.accountDetail: Your profile, password, two-step verification and where you are signed in.
settings.membersDetail: Who can sign in to Files, and with which role. Users reach their own files and links; viewers also see the spaces and every link; editors also stop anyone's link; admins also sync, plan handovers and manage members and tokens.
settings.signinDetail: Identity providers people can sign in with, such as OpenAsy Identity, Keycloak or Microsoft Entra ID, and which of their groups give which role.
settings.tokensDetail: For scripts. Each token has one role and an expiry; the secret is shown once. Tokens never reach anyone's files.
